defect: binary mode decode drives asynchronous reset
rationale: A binary counter can transiently decode zero while bits change, creating a spurious asynchronous reset pulse.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: An async reset decoded combinationally from a multi-bit counter can glitch during transitions (e.g. 001->010) and spuriously reset work.
